svg.aria-label: Animated diagram: the model reads one Latin line five times; the most typical run becomes the reference; the others are aligned against it; agreement per word is counted and low-agreement words are highlighted.

g.text: The model reads the same line five times. Sampling lets each pass come out a little differently.
The run closest to all the others becomes the reference: the most typical reading, not the right one.
Every other run is aligned to the reference, character by character, and each difference is marked.
Agreement is counted per word. Low agreement marks a likely error, so look there first.
ON THE PAGE · GOSPEL LECTIONARY, GETTY MS. 16, LINE 3
80% agree on “cis” — but the Latin needs “eis”. Agreement is not accuracy.
